GOAL: Be the last player remaining in the game by bankrupting all other opponents.

MOVEMENT_AND_DICE.Normal_Turn: Roll 2 dice. Move that many spaces.
MOVEMENT_AND_DICE.Doubles: If you roll a double, you take your turn, then roll again. If you roll 3 doubles in a row, you go directly to Jail immediately without passing Go.

GO_SPACE.Rule: Every time you land on or pass over the 'Go' space, the Bank pays you $200.

PROPERTIES_AND_AUCTIONS.Unowned_Property: If you land on an unowned property, you can buy it at the printed base price.
PROPERTIES_AND_AUCTIONS.Auction: If you choose NOT to buy it, the property is immediately auctioned to the highest bidder. ANY player can bid, including the player who passed on the initial purchase.

RENT_AND_MONOPOLIES.Paying_Rent: If you land on an opponent's unmortgaged property, you must pay rent based on the property's development level.
RENT_AND_MONOPOLIES.Monopoly_Multiplier: If a player owns ALL properties of a color group, the rent for UNIMPROVED properties in that group is DOUBLED.
RENT_AND_MONOPOLIES.Railroads: Rent depends on how many Railroads the owner holds (1=$25, 2=$50, 3=$100, 4=$200).
RENT_AND_MONOPOLIES.Utilities: Rent is a multiplier of the dice roll. If 1 is owned: 4x the roll. If both are owned: 10x the roll.

JAIL_MECHANICS.Going_to_Jail: You go to jail if you land on 'Go To Jail', draw a 'Go to Jail' card, or roll 3 consecutive doubles. You do not collect $200.
JAIL_MECHANICS.Getting_Out: 1) Pay $50 bail before rolling. 2) Roll doubles on your turn. 3) Use a 'Get out of Jail Free' card. If you don't roll doubles by your 3rd turn in Jail, you MUST pay $50.
JAIL_MECHANICS.While_in_Jail: You CAN still collect rent, buy properties in auctions, trade, build, and mortgage while in Jail.

BUILDING_HOUSES_AND_HOTELS.Prerequisite: You MUST own all properties of a color group (a Monopoly) before building.
BUILDING_HOUSES_AND_HOTELS.Even_Build_Rule: You MUST build evenly. You cannot have 2 houses on one property if another in the same group has 0. You must upgrade them simultaneously.
BUILDING_HOUSES_AND_HOTELS.Hotels: To buy a Hotel, you must first have 4 houses on the property. A Hotel replaces the 4 houses.
BUILDING_HOUSES_AND_HOTELS.Selling_Buildings: Buildings can be sold back to the Bank at any time for HALF their purchase price (must be sold evenly).

MORTGAGES.Rule: You can mortgage an unimproved property to receive 50% of its base price from the Bank. Mortgaged properties collect $0 rent.
MORTGAGES.Constraint: You CANNOT mortgage a property if ANY property in its color group has houses. All houses must be sold first.
MORTGAGES.Unmortgaging: To lift a mortgage, you must pay the Bank the mortgage value plus 10% interest.

BANKRUPTCY.Rule: If you owe more money than you can pay (using cash, selling buildings, and mortgaging), you are Bankrupt.
BANKRUPTCY.To_Another_Player: If you owe a player, they get all your cash and mortgaged/unmortgaged properties.
BANKRUPTCY.To_The_Bank: If you owe the Bank (taxes/cards), all your properties are auctioned off to the remaining players.

TRADING_AND_NEGOTIATION.Rule: You can trade unimproved properties, railroads, and utilities with ANY player for cash or other properties.
TRADING_AND_NEGOTIATION.Constraint: You CANNOT trade properties that have buildings. If you want to trade a property from a color group that has buildings, you must sell ALL buildings in that group back to the Bank first.
TRADING_AND_NEGOTIATION.Strategy: Use trades to complete your color monopolies, or to acquire key blocking properties. DO NOT accept a trade if it gives your opponent a dangerous monopoly without adequate compensation.
